title: Arithmetic Progression Additions
statement:
Apply all inclusive progression updates using difference arrays for slope and intercept.

Input
n q, the initial n values, then q lines L R x d. Add x+(i−L)d at every index i from L through R.

Output
Print the final values in order.

Constraints
1 ≤ n ≤ 200000, 0 ≤ q ≤ 200000, 1 ≤ L ≤ R ≤ n. Initial values, x, and d have absolute value at most 10⁶.
